He said: “Are the lice on your head bothering you?” I said: “Yes.” He called for a barber, who shaved my head, then he ordered me to make an expiation.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5666, book 75, باب قَوْلِ الْمَرِيضِ إِنِّي وَجِعٌ أَوْ وَارَأْسَاهْ، أَوِ اشْتَدَّ بِي الْوَجَعُ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى أَبُو زَكَرِيَّاءَ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلاَلٍ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْقَاسِمَ بْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالَ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ وَارَأْسَاهْ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ ذَاكِ لَوْ كَانَ وَأَنَا حَىٌّ، فَأَسْتَغْفِرُ لَكِ وَأَدْعُو لَكِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ وَاثُكْلِيَاهْ، وَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لأَظُنُّكَ تُحِبُّ مَوْتِي، وَلَوْ كَانَ ذَاكَ لَظَلِلْتَ آخِرَ يَوْمِكَ مُعَرِّسًا بِبَعْضِ أَزْوَاجِكَ‏.‏ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ بَلْ أَنَا وَارَأْسَاهْ لَقَدْ هَمَمْتُ أَوْ أَرَدْتُ أَنْ أُرْسِلَ إِلَى أَبِي بَكْرٍ وَابْنِهِ، وَأَعْهَدَ أَنْ يَقُولَ الْقَائِلُونَ أَوْ يَتَمَنَّى الْمُتَمَنُّونَ، ثُمَّ قُلْتُ يَأْبَى اللَّهُ وَيَدْفَعُ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ، أَوْ يَدْفَعُ اللَّهُ وَيَأْبَى الْمُؤْمِنُونَ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Yahya ibn Yahya Abu Zakariyya narrated to us; Sulayman ibn Bilal informed us, from Yahya ibn Said, who said: I heard al-Qasim ibn Muhammad say: Aishah said, “Oh, my head!” The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said: “That would be so if it happened while I was alive; I would ask forgiveness for you and pray for you.” Aishah said: “Oh, my loss! By Allah, I think you want me to die, so that you could spend the rest of your day with one of your other wives.” The Prophet said: “Rather, I have a headache too. I had intended—or wanted—to send for Abu Bakr and his son and make a bequest, lest someone make claims or wishful demands. Then I said: Allah will refuse it, and the believers will prevent it—or Allah will prevent it, and the believers will refuse it.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5667, book 75, باب قَوْلِ الْمَرِيضِ إِنِّي وَجِعٌ أَوْ وَارَأْسَاهْ، أَوِ اشْتَدَّ بِي الْوَجَعُ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ التَّيْمِيِّ، عَنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ دَخَلْتُ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهْوَ يُوعَكُ فَمَسِسْتُهُ فَقُلْتُ إِنَّكَ لَتُوعَكُ وَعْكًا شَدِيدًا‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَجَلْ كَمَا يُوعَكُ رَجُلاَنِ مِنْكُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ لَكَ أَجْرَانِ قَالَ ‏"‏ نَعَمْ مَا مِنْ مُسْلِمٍ يُصِيبُهُ أَذًى مَرَضٌ فَمَا سِوَاهُ إِلاَّ حَطَّ اللَّهُ سَيِّئَاتِهِ كَمَا تَحُطُّ الشَّجَرَةُ وَرَقَهَا ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Musa narrated to us; Abd al-Aziz ibn Muslim narrated to us; Sulayman narrated to us, from Ibrahim al-Taymi, from al-Harith ibn Suwayd, from Ibn Masud, may Allah be pleased with him, who said: I visited the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, while he was suffering fever. I touched him and said: You are suffering a severe fever. He said: “Yes, as severely as two men among you.” I said: You will have a double reward? He said: “Yes. No Muslim is afflicted by harm, illness, or anything else except that Allah removes his sins as a tree sheds its leaves.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5668, book 75, باب قَوْلِ الْمَرِيضِ إِنِّي وَجِعٌ أَوْ وَارَأْسَاهْ، أَوِ اشْتَدَّ بِي الْوَجَعُ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، أَخْبَرَنَا الزُّهْرِيُّ، عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ جَاءَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَعُودُنِي مِنْ وَجَعٍ اشْتَدَّ بِي زَمَنَ حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ فَقُلْتُ بَلَغَ بِي مَا تَرَى وَأَنَا ذُو مَالٍ وَلاَ يَرِثُنِي إِلاَّ ابْنَةٌ لِي أَفَأَتَصَدَّقُ بِثُلُثَىْ مَالِي قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ بِالشَّطْرِ قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ الثُّلُثُ قَالَ ‏"‏ الثُّلُثُ كَثِيرٌ، أَنْ تَدَعَ وَرَثَتَكَ أَغْنِيَاءَ خَيْرٌ مِنْ أَنْ تَذَرَهُمْ عَالَةً يَتَكَفَّفُونَ النَّاسَ وَلَنْ تُنْفِقَ نَفَقَةً تَبْتَغِي بِهَا وَجْهَ اللَّهِ إِلاَّ أُجِرْتَ عَلَيْهَا حَتَّى مَا تَجْعَلُ فِي فِي امْرَأَتِكَ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Musa ibn Ismail narrated to us; Abd al-Aziz ibn Abdullah ibn Abi Salamah narrated to us; al-Zuhri informed us, from Amir ibn Sad, from his father, who said: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, came to visit me because of an illness that had become severe during the Farewell Pilgrimage. I said: My illness has reached this state, and I have wealth, but only one daughter will inherit from me. May I give two-thirds of my wealth in charity? He said: “No.” I said: Half? He said: “No.” I said: A third? He said: “A third is a lot. It is better for you to leave your heirs wealthy than to leave them dependent, begging from people. Whatever you spend seeking Allah's pleasure will be rewarded, even what you place in your wife's mouth.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5669, book 75, باب قَوْلِ الْمَرِيضِ قُومُوا عَنِّي
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ لَمَّا حُضِرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَفِي الْبَيْتِ رِجَالٌ فِيهِمْ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ هَلُمَّ أَكْتُبْ لَكُمْ كِتَابًا لاَ تَضِلُّوا بَعْدَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ إِنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَدْ غَلَبَ عَلَيْهِ الْوَجَعُ وَعِنْدَكُمُ الْقُرْآنُ، حَسْبُنَا كِتَابُ اللَّهِ فَاخْتَلَفَ أَهْلُ الْبَيْتِ فَاخْتَصَمُوا، مِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَقُولُ قَرِّبُوا يَكْتُبْ لَكُمُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كِتَابًا لَنْ تَضِلُّوا بَعْدَهُ، وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَقُولُ مَا قَالَ عُمَرُ فَلَمَّا أَكْثَرُوا اللَّغْوَ وَالاِخْتِلاَفَ عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ قُومُوا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ فَكَانَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ يَقُولُ إِنَّ الرَّزِيَّةَ كُلَّ الرَّزِيَّةِ مَا حَالَ بَيْنَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَبَيْنَ أَنْ يَكْتُبَ لَهُمْ ذَلِكَ الْكِتَابَ مِنِ اخْتِلاَفِهِمْ وَلَغَطِهِمْ‏.‏
en_text: Ibrahim ibn Musa narrated to us; Hisham narrated to us, from Mamar. Abdullah ibn Muhammad narrated to me; Abd al-Razzaq narrated to us; Mamar informed us, from al-Zuhri, from Ubaydullah ibn Abdullah, from Ibn Abbas, may Allah be pleased with them both, who said: When the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, was near death, there were men in the house, including Umar ibn al-Khattab. The Prophet said: “Come, let me write for you a document after which you will not go astray.” Umar said: “The Prophet has been overcome by pain, and you have the Quran. The Book of Allah is enough for us.” The people in the house disagreed and argued. Some said: “Bring writing materials so the Prophet can write a document for you after which you will not go astray.” Others said what Umar had said. When they argued and spoke loudly in the Prophet's presence, the Messenger of Allah said: “Get up and leave.” Ubaydullah said: Ibn Abbas used to say: “The greatest calamity was that their disagreement and noise came between the Messenger of Allah and writing that document for them.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5670, book 75, باب مَنْ ذَهَبَ بِالصَّبِيِّ الْمَرِيضِ لِيُدْعَى لَهُ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ حَمْزَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا حَاتِمٌ ـ هُوَ ابْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ ـ عَنِ الْجُعَيْدِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ السَّائِبَ، يَقُولُ ذَهَبَتْ بِي خَالَتِي إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ ابْنَ أُخْتِي وَجِعٌ فَمَسَحَ رَأْسِي وَدَعَا لِي بِالْبَرَكَةِ، ثُمَّ تَوَضَّأَ فَشَرِبْتُ مِنْ وَضُوئِهِ وَقُمْتُ خَلْفَ ظَهْرِهِ فَنَظَرْتُ إِلَى خَاتَمِ النُّبُوَّةِ بَيْنَ كَتِفَيْهِ مِثْلَ زِرِّ الْحَجَلَةِ‏.‏
en_text: Ibrahim ibn Hamzah narrated to us; Hatim—Ibn Ismail—informed us, from al-Juayd, who said: I heard al-Saib say: My maternal aunt took me to the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, and said: “Messenger of Allah, my sister's son is ill.” He wiped my head and prayed for blessing for me, then performed ablution. I drank from the water of his ablution and stood behind him, where I saw the Seal of Prophethood between his shoulders, like the button of a bridal canopy.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5671, book 75, باب تَمَنِّي الْمَرِيضِ الْمَوْتَ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا ثَابِتٌ الْبُنَانِيُّ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لاَ يَتَمَنَّيَنَّ أَحَدُكُمُ الْمَوْتَ مِنْ ضُرٍّ أَصَابَهُ، فَإِنْ كَانَ لاَ بُدَّ فَاعِلاً فَلْيَقُلِ اللَّهُمَّ أَحْيِنِي مَا كَانَتِ الْحَيَاةُ خَيْرًا لِي، وَتَوَفَّنِي إِذَا كَانَتِ الْوَفَاةُ خَيْرًا لِي ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Adam narrated to us; Shu'bah narrated to us; Thabit al-Bunani narrated to us, from Anas ibn Malik, may Allah be pleased with him, who said: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said: “Let none of you wish for death because of a hardship that has befallen him. If he must do so, let him say: O Allah, keep me alive as long as life is better for me, and let me die when death is better for me.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5672, book 75, باب تَمَنِّي الْمَرِيضِ الْمَوْتَ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أَبِي خَالِدٍ، عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، قَالَ دَخَلْنَا عَلَى خَبَّابٍ نَعُودُهُ وَقَدِ اكْتَوَى سَبْعَ كَيَّاتٍ فَقَالَ إِنَّ أَصْحَابَنَا الَّذِينَ سَلَفُوا مَضَوْا وَلَمْ تَنْقُصْهُمُ الدُّنْيَا وَإِنَّا أَصَبْنَا مَا لاَ نَجِدُ لَهُ مَوْضِعًا إِلاَّ التُّرَابَ وَلَوْلاَ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَانَا أَنْ نَدْعُوَ بِالْمَوْتِ لَدَعَوْتُ بِهِ، ثُمَّ أَتَيْنَاهُ مَرَّةً أُخْرَى وَهْوَ يَبْنِي حَائِطًا لَهُ فَقَالَ إِنَّ الْمُسْلِمَ لَيُوجَرُ فِي كُلِّ شَىْءٍ يُنْفِقُهُ إِلاَّ فِي شَىْءٍ يَجْعَلُهُ فِي هَذَا التُّرَابِ‏.‏
en_text: Adam narrated to us; Shu'bah narrated to us, from Ismail ibn Abi Khalid, from Qays ibn Abi Hazim, who said: We visited Khabbab while he was ill; he had been cauterized seven times. He said: Our companions who came before us have passed away without the world diminishing their reward. We have acquired wealth for which we find no place but the soil. Were it not that the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, forbade us to pray for death, I would have prayed for it. Then we visited him another time while he was building a wall for himself. He said: A Muslim is rewarded for everything he spends, except for what he puts into this soil.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5673, book 75, باب تَمَنِّي الْمَرِيضِ الْمَوْتَ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو عُبَيْدٍ، مَوْلَى عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ لَنْ يُدْخِلَ أَحَدًا عَمَلُهُ الْجَنَّةَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا وَلاَ أَنْتَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ، وَلاَ أَنَا إِلاَّ أَنْ يَتَغَمَّدَنِي اللَّهُ بِفَضْلٍ وَرَحْمَةٍ فَسَدِّدُوا وَقَارِبُوا وَلاَ يَتَمَنَّيَنَّ أَحَدُكُمُ الْمَوْتَ إِمَّا مُحْسِنًا فَلَعَلَّهُ أَنْ يَزْدَادَ خَيْرًا، وَإِمَّا مُسِيئًا فَلَعَلَّهُ أَنْ يَسْتَعْتِبَ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Abu al-Yaman narrated to us; Shuayb informed us, from al-Zuhri, who said: Abu Ubayd, the freedman of Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf, informed me that Abu Hurairah said: I heard the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, say: “No one's deeds alone will admit him to Paradise.” They said: “Not even you, Messenger of Allah?” He said: “Not even me, unless Allah envelops me in His bounty and mercy. So act rightly and aim for what is close to perfection. Let none of you wish for death: if he is doing good, perhaps he will increase in good; and if he is doing wrong, perhaps he will seek to make amends.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5674, book 75, باب تَمَنِّي الْمَرِيضِ الْمَوْتَ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ عَبَّادِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهْوَ مُسْتَنِدٌ إِلَىَّ يَقُولُ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَارْحَمْنِي وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالرَّفِيقِ الأَعْلَى ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Abdullah ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us; Abu Usamah narrated to us, from Hisham, from Abbad ibn Abdullah ibn al-Zubayr, who said: I heard Aishah, may Allah be pleased with her, say: I heard the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, while he was leaning against me, say: “O Allah, forgive me, have mercy on me, and join me with the Highest Companion.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5675, book 75, باب دُعَاءِ الْعَائِدِ لِلْمَرِيضِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ إِذَا أَتَى مَرِيضًا ـ أَوْ أُتِيَ بِهِ ـ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَذْهِبِ الْبَاسَ رَبَّ النَّاسِ، اشْفِ وَأَنْتَ الشَّافِي لاَ شِفَاءَ إِلاَّ شِفَاؤُكَ، شِفَاءً لاَ يُغَادِرُ سَقَمًا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ عَمْرُو بْنُ أَبِي قَيْسٍ وَإِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ طَهْمَانَ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَأَبِي الضُّحَى إِذَا أُتِيَ بِالْمَرِيضِ، وَقَالَ جَرِيرٌ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ عَنْ أَبِي الضُّحَى وَحْدَهُ، وَقَالَ إِذَا أَتَى مَرِيضًا‏.‏
en_text: Musa ibn Ismail narrated to us; Abu Awanah narrated to us, from Mansur, from Ibrahim, from Masruq, from Aishah, may Allah be pleased with her: Whenever the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, visited a sick person—or a sick person was brought to him—he would say: “Remove the suffering, Lord of mankind; heal, for You are the Healer. There is no healing except Your healing, a healing that leaves no illness behind.” Amr ibn Abi Qays and Ibrahim ibn Tahman reported from Mansur, from Ibrahim and Abu al-Duha: when the sick person was brought to him. Jarir reported from Mansur, from Abu al-Duha alone, who said: when he visited a sick person.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5676, book 75, باب وُضُوءِ الْعَائِدِ لِلْمَرِيضِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ دَخَلَ عَلَىَّ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَنَا مَرِيضٌ فَتَوَضَّأَ فَصَبَّ عَلَىَّ أَوْ قَالَ صُبُّوا عَلَيْهِ فَعَقَلْتُ فَقُلْتُ لاَ يَرِثُنِي إِلاَّ كَلاَلَةٌ، فَكَيْفَ الْمِيرَاثُ فَنَزَلَتْ آيَةُ الْفَرَائِضِ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn Bashshar narrated to us; Ghundar narrated to us; Shu'bah narrated to us, from Muhammad ibn al-Munkadir, who said: I heard Jabir ibn Abdullah, may Allah be pleased with them both, say: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, came to me while I was ill, performed ablution, and poured the water over me—or he said: “Pour it over him.” I regained my senses and said: I will be inherited from only by distant relatives; how will the inheritance be divided? Then the verse of inheritance was revealed.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5677, book 75, باب مَنْ دَعَا بِرَفْعِ الْوَبَاءِ وَالْحُمَّى
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ لَمَّا قَدِمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وُعِكَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ وَبِلاَلٌ قَالَتْ فَدَخَلْتُ عَلَيْهِمَا فَقُلْتُ يَا أَبَتِ كَيْفَ تَجِدُكَ وَيَا بِلاَلُ كَيْفَ تَجِدُكَ قَالَتْ وَكَانَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ إِذَا أَخَذَتْهُ الْحُمَّى يَقُولُ كُلُّ امْرِئٍ مُصَبَّحٌ فِي أَهْلِهِ وَالْمَوْتُ أَدْنَى مِنْ شِرَاكِ نَعْلِهِ وَكَانَ بِلاَلٌ إِذَا أُقْلِعَ عَنْهُ يَرْفَعُ عَقِيرَتَهُ فَيَقُولُ أَلاَ لَيْتَ شِعْرِي هَلْ أَبِيتَنَّ لَيْلَةً بِوَادٍ وَحَوْلِي إِذْخِرٌ وَجَلِيلُ وَهَلْ أَرِدَنْ يَوْمًا مِيَاهَ مِجَنَّةٍ وَهَلْ تَبْدُوَنْ لِي شَامَةٌ وَطَفِيلُ قَالَ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ فَجِئْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ حَبِّبْ إِلَيْنَا الْمَدِينَةَ كَحُبِّنَا مَكَّةَ أَوْ أَشَدَّ وَصَحِّحْهَا وَبَارِكْ لَنَا فِي صَاعِهَا وَمُدِّهَا وَانْقُلْ حُمَّاهَا فَاجْعَلْهَا بِالْجُحْفَةِ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Ismail narrated to us: Malik narrated to me, from Hisham ibn Urwah, from his father, from Aishah, may Allah be pleased with her, who said: When the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, arrived, Abu Bakr and Bilal became ill with fever. I went in to them and said: “Father, how are you feeling? Bilal, how are you feeling?” When Abu Bakr was overcome by fever, he would say: “Every man wakes among his family, while death is nearer to him than his sandal strap.” When Bilal's fever subsided, he would raise his voice and say: “Would that I knew whether I will spend a night in a valley, with idhkhir and jalil grasses around me; whether I will one day reach the waters of Majannah; and whether Shamah and Tufayl will appear to me.” Aishah said: I went to the Messenger of Allah and told him. He said: “O Allah, make Medina as beloved to us as Mecca, or even more; make it healthy for us, bless its sa and mudd, and move its fever to al-Juhfah.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5678, book 76, باب مَا أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ دَاءً إِلاَّ أَنْزَلَ لَهُ شِفَاءً
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أَحْمَدَ الزُّبَيْرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي حُسَيْنٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَطَاءُ بْنُ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ مَا أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ دَاءً إِلاَّ أَنْزَلَ لَهُ شِفَاءً ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna narrated to us; Abu Ahmad al-Zubayri narrated to us; Umar ibn Said ibn Abi Husayn narrated to us, saying: Ata ibn Abi Rabah narrated to me, from Abu Hurairah, may Allah be pleased with him, from the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, who said: “Allah has not sent down any disease without also sending down a cure for it.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5679, book 76, باب هَلْ يُدَاوِي الرَّجُلُ الْمَرْأَةَ أَوِ الْمَرْأَةُ الرَّجُلَ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ الْمُفَضَّلِ، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ ذَكْوَانَ، عَنْ رُبَيِّعَ بِنْتِ مُعَوِّذٍ ابْنِ عَفْرَاءَ، قَالَتْ كُنَّا نَغْزُو مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَسْقِي الْقَوْمَ، وَنَخْدُمُهُمْ، وَنَرُدُّ الْقَتْلَى وَالْجَرْحَى إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ‏.‏
en_text: Qutaybah ibn Said narrated to us; Bishr ibn al-Mufaddal narrated to us, from Khalid ibn Dhakwan, from Rubayyi bint Muawwidh ibn Afra, who said: We went on military expeditions with the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him. We gave the people water, served them, and took the dead and wounded back to Medina.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5680, book 76, باب الشِّفَاءُ فِي ثَلاَثٍ
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي الْحُسَيْنُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مَنِيعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ شُجَاعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سَالِمٌ الأَفْطَسُ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ ‏"‏ الشِّفَاءُ فِي ثَلاَثَةٍ شَرْبَةِ عَسَلٍ، وَشَرْطَةِ مِحْجَمٍ، وَكَيَّةِ نَارٍ، وَأَنْهَى أُمَّتِي عَنِ الْكَىِّ ‏"‏‏.‏ رَفَعَ الْحَدِيثَ وَرَوَاهُ الْقُمِّيُّ عَنْ لَيْثٍ عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الْعَسَلِ وَالْحَجْمِ‏.‏
en_text: Al-Husayn narrated to me; Ahmad ibn Mani narrated to us; Marwan ibn Shuja narrated to us; Salim al-Aftas narrated to us, from Said ibn Jubayr, from Ibn Abbas, may Allah be pleased with them both, who said: “Healing is in three things: a drink of honey, a cut made by cupping, and cauterization with fire. I forbid my community from cauterization.” He attributed the report to the Prophet. Al-Qummi reported it from Layth, from Mujahid, from Ibn Abbas, from the Prophet, regarding honey and cupping.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5681, book 76, باب الشِّفَاءُ فِي ثَلاَثٍ
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحِيمِ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُرَيْجُ بْنُ يُونُسَ أَبُو الْحَارِثِ، حَدَّثَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ شُجَاعٍ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ الأَفْطَسِ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ الشِّفَاءُ فِي ثَلاَثَةٍ شَرْطَةِ مِحْجَمٍ، أَوْ شَرْبَةِ عَسَلٍ، أَوْ كَيَّةٍ بِنَارٍ، وَأَنْهَى أُمَّتِي عَنِ الْكَىِّ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn Abd al-Rahim narrated to me; Surayj ibn Yunus Abu al-Harith informed us; Marwan ibn Shuja narrated to us, from Salim al-Aftas, from Said ibn Jubayr, from Ibn Abbas, from the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, who said: “Healing is in three things: the incision of cupping, a drink of honey, or cauterization with fire. I forbid my community from cauterization.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5683, book 76, بَابُ الدَّوَاءِ بِالْعَسَلِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ الْغَسِيلِ، عَنْ عَاصِمِ بْنِ عُمَرَ بْنِ قَتَادَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ إِنْ كَانَ فِي شَىْءٍ مِنْ أَدْوِيَتِكُمْ ـ أَوْ يَكُونُ فِي شَىْءٍ مِنْ أَدْوِيَتِكُمْ ـ خَيْرٌ فَفِي شَرْطَةِ مِحْجَمٍ، أَوْ شَرْبَةِ عَسَلٍ، أَوْ لَذْعَةٍ بِنَارٍ تُوَافِقُ الدَّاءَ، وَمَا أُحِبُّ أَنْ أَكْتَوِيَ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Abu Nuaim narrated to us; Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Ghasil narrated to us, from Asim ibn Umar ibn Qatadah, who said: I heard Jabir ibn Abdullah, may Allah be pleased with them both, say: I heard the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, say: “If there is good in any of your remedies—or if there can be good in any of your remedies—it is in the incision of cupping, a drink of honey, or a cauterizing touch with fire that matches the illness. I do not like to be cauterized.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5684, book 76, بَابُ الدَّوَاءِ بِالْعَسَلِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عَيَّاشُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الْمُتَوَكِّلِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، أَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ أَخِي يَشْتَكِي بَطْنَهُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اسْقِهِ عَسَلاً ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ أَتَى الثَّانِيَةَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اسْقِهِ عَسَلاً ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ أَتَاهُ فَقَالَ فَعَلْتُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ صَدَقَ اللَّهُ، وَكَذَبَ بَطْنُ أَخِيكَ، اسْقِهِ عَسَلاً ‏"‏‏.‏ فَسَقَاهُ فَبَرَأَ‏.‏
en_text: Ayyash ibn al-Walid narrated to us; Abd al-Ala narrated to us; Said narrated to us, from Qatadah, from Abu al-Mutawakkil, from Abu Said: A man came to the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, and said: “My brother is suffering from his stomach.” He said: “Give him honey to drink.” The man came a second time, and he said: “Give him honey to drink.” Then he came again and said: “I have done so.” He said: “Allah has spoken the truth, but your brother's stomach has lied. Give him honey to drink.” So he gave it to him, and he recovered.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5685, book 76, باب الدَّوَاءِ بِأَلْبَانِ الإِبِلِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا سَلاَّمُ بْنُ مِسْكِينٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ثَابِتٌ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، أَنَّ نَاسًا، كَانَ بِهِمْ سَقَمٌ قَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ آوِنَا وَأَطْعِمْنَا فَلَمَّا صَحُّوا قَالُوا إِنَّ الْمَدِينَةَ وَخِمَةٌ‏.‏ فَأَنْزَلَهُمُ الْحَرَّةَ فِي ذَوْدٍ لَهُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اشْرَبُوا أَلْبَانَهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَلَمَّا صَحُّوا قَتَلُوا رَاعِيَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَاسْتَاقُوا ذَوْدَهُ، فَبَعَثَ فِي آثَارِهِمْ، فَقَطَعَ أَيْدِيَهُمْ وَأَرْجُلَهُمْ، وَسَمَرَ أَعْيُنَهُمْ، فَرَأَيْتُ الرَّجُلَ مِنْهُمْ يَكْدُمُ الأَرْضَ بِلِسَانِهِ حَتَّى يَمُوتَ‏.‏ قَالَ سَلاَّمٌ فَبَلَغَنِي أَنَّ الْحَجَّاجَ قَالَ لأَنَسٍ حَدِّثْنِي بِأَشَدِّ عُقُوبَةٍ عَاقَبَهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَحَدَّثَهُ بِهَذَا‏.‏ فَبَلَغَ الْحَسَنَ فَقَالَ وَدِدْتُ أَنَّهُ لَمْ يُحَدِّثْهُ‏ بِهَذَا
en_text: Muslim ibn Ibrahim narrated to us; Sallam ibn Miskin narrated to us; Thabit narrated to us, from Anas: Some people were ill and said: “Messenger of Allah, give us shelter and food.” When they recovered, they said: “The climate of Medina does not suit us.” He lodged them in the open rocky outskirts with some camels and said: “Drink their milk.” When they recovered, they killed the Prophet's shepherd and drove off the camels. He sent people after them, who caught them; he had their hands and feet cut off and their eyes branded. I saw one of them bite the ground with his tongue until he died. Sallam said: I heard that al-Hajjaj said to Anas: “Tell me about the harshest punishment the Prophet inflicted.” Anas told him this account. When al-Hasan heard of it, he said: “I wish he had not told him this.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5686, book 76, باب الدَّوَاءِ بِأَبْوَالِ الإِبِلِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ نَاسًا، اجْتَوَوْا فِي الْمَدِينَةِ فَأَمَرَهُمُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يَلْحَقُوا بِرَاعِيهِ ـ يَعْنِي الإِبِلَ ـ فَيَشْرَبُوا مِنْ أَلْبَانِهَا وَأَبْوَالِهَا، فَلَحِقُوا بِرَاعِيهِ فَشَرِبُوا مِنْ أَلْبَانِهَا وَأَبْوَالِهَا، حَتَّى صَلَحَتْ أَبْدَانُهُمْ فَقَتَلُوا الرَّاعِيَ وَسَاقُوا الإِبِلَ، فَبَلَغَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَبَعَثَ فِي طَلَبِهِمْ، فَجِيءَ بِهِمْ فَقَطَعَ أَيْدِيَهُمْ وَأَرْجُلَهُمْ، وَسَمَرَ أَعْيُنَهُمْ‏.‏ قَالَ قَتَادَةُ فَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سِيرِينَ أَنَّ ذَلِكَ كَانَ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَنْزِلَ الْحُدُودُ‏.‏
en_text: Musa ibn Ismail narrated to us; Hammam narrated to us, from Qatadah, from Anas, may Allah be pleased with him: Some people found Medina's climate disagreeable, so the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, ordered them to join the camel herder and drink the camels' milk and urine. They joined the herder and drank from their milk and urine until their bodies recovered. Then they killed the herder and drove off the camels. When news reached the Prophet, he sent people to pursue them. They were brought back, and he had their hands and feet cut off and their eyes branded. Qatadah said: Muhammad ibn Sirin told me that this happened before the legal punishments were revealed.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5687, book 76, باب الْحَبَّةِ السَّوْدَاءِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، قَالَ خَرَجْنَا وَمَعَنَا غَالِبُ بْنُ أَبْجَرَ فَمَرِضَ فِي الطَّرِيقِ، فَقَدِمْنَا الْمَدِينَةَ وَهْوَ مَرِيضٌ، فَعَادَهُ ابْنُ أَبِي عَتِيقٍ فَقَالَ لَنَا عَلَيْكُمْ بِهَذِهِ الْحُبَيْبَةِ السَّوْدَاءِ، فَخُذُوا مِنْهَا خَمْسًا أَوْ سَبْعًا فَاسْحَقُوهَا، ثُمَّ اقْطُرُوهَا فِي أَنْفِهِ بِقَطَرَاتِ زَيْتٍ فِي هَذَا الْجَانِبِ وَفِي هَذَا الْجَانِبِ، فَإِنَّ عَائِشَةَ حَدَّثَتْنِي أَنَّهَا سَمِعَتِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ إِنَّ هَذِهِ الْحَبَّةَ السَّوْدَاءَ شِفَاءٌ مِنْ كُلِّ دَاءٍ إِلاَّ مِنَ السَّامِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ وَمَا السَّامُ قَالَ الْمَوْتُ‏.‏
en_text: Abdullah ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us; Ubaydullah narrated to us; Israil narrated to us, from Mansur, from Khalid ibn Sad, who said: We set out with us was Ghalib ibn Abjar, and he became ill on the road. We arrived in Medina while he was ill, and Ibn Abi Atiq visited him. He said to us: “Use this black seed. Take five or seven of them, crush them, then put drops of oil into the nostrils on both sides. Aishah told me that she heard the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, say: ‘This black seed is a cure for every illness except death.’” I asked: “What is death?” He said: “Death.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5688, book 76, باب الْحَبَّةِ السَّوْدَاءِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ عُقَيْلٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ، وَسَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ، أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، أَخْبَرَهُمَا أَنَّهُ، سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ فِي الْحَبَّةِ السَّوْدَاءِ شِفَاءٌ مِنْ كُلِّ دَاءٍ إِلاَّ السَّامَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ وَالسَّامُ الْمَوْتُ، وَالْحَبَّةُ السَّوْدَاءُ الشُّونِيزُ‏.‏
en_text: Yahya ibn Bukayr narrated to us; al-Layth narrated to us, from Uqayl, from Ibn Shihab, who said: Abu Salamah and Said ibn al-Musayyab informed me that Abu Hurairah informed them that he heard the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, say: “In the black seed there is a cure for every illness except death.” Ibn Shihab said: Death means dying, and the black seed is shuniz.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5689, book 76, باب التَّلْبِينَةِ لِلْمَرِيضِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا حِبَّانُ بْنُ مُوسَى، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا يُونُسُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ عُقَيْلٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ أَنَّهَا كَانَتْ تَأْمُرُ بِالتَّلْبِينِ لِلْمَرِيضِ وَلِلْمَحْزُونِ عَلَى الْهَالِكِ، وَكَانَتْ تَقُولُ إِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ إِنَّ التَّلْبِينَةَ تُجِمُّ فُؤَادَ الْمَرِيضِ، وَتَذْهَبُ بِبَعْضِ الْحُزْنِ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Hibban ibn Musa informed us; Abdullah informed us; Yunus ibn Yazid informed us, from Uqayl, from Ibn Shihab, from Urwah, from Aishah, may Allah be pleased with her, that she used to recommend talbinah for the sick and for those grieving a deceased person. She used to say: I heard the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, say: “Talbinah comforts the heart of the sick person and relieves some of the grief.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5690, book 76, باب التَّلْبِينَةِ لِلْمَرِيضِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا فَرْوَةُ بْنُ أَبِي الْمَغْرَاءِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّهَا كَانَتْ تَأْمُرُ بِالتَّلْبِينَةِ وَتَقُولُ هُوَ الْبَغِيضُ النَّافِعُ‏.‏
en_text: Farwah ibn Abi al-Maghra narrated to us; Ali ibn Mushir narrated to us, from Hisham, from his father, from Aishah, who used to recommend talbinah and say: “It is disliked but beneficial.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5691, book 76, باب السَّعُوطِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُعَلَّى بْنُ أَسَدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم احْتَجَمَ وَأَعْطَى الْحَجَّامَ أَجْرَهُ وَاسْتَعَطَ‏.‏
en_text: Mual la ibn Asad narrated to us; Wuhayb narrated to us, from Ibn Tawus, from his father, from Ibn Abbas, may Allah be pleased with them both: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, had cupping performed, paid the cupper, and used nasal medication.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5692, 5693, book 76, باب السَّعُوطِ بِالْقُسْطِ الْهِنْدِيِّ الْبَحْرِيِّ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا صَدَقَةُ بْنُ الْفَضْلِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الزُّهْرِيَّ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أُمِّ قَيْسٍ بِنْتِ مِحْصَنٍ، قَالَتْ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ عَلَيْكُمْ بِهَذَا الْعُودِ الْهِنْدِيِّ، فَإِنَّ فِيهِ سَبْعَةَ أَشْفِيَةٍ‏.‏ يُسْتَعَطُ بِهِ مِنَ الْعُذْرَةِ، وَيُلَدُّ بِهِ مِنْ ذَاتِ الْجَنْبِ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَدَخَلْتُ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِابْنٍ لِي لَمْ يَأْكُلِ الطَّعَامَ فَبَالَ عَلَيْهِ، فَدَعَا بِمَاءٍ فَرَشَّ عَلَيْهِ‏.‏
en_text: Sadaqah ibn al-Fadl narrated to us; Ibn Uyaynah informed us, saying: I heard al-Zuhri, from Ubaydullah, from Umm Qays bint Mihsan, who said: I heard the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, say: “Use this Indian wood, for it contains seven remedies. It is used as nasal medicine for tonsillitis and administered into the side of the mouth for pleurisy.” She also came to the Prophet with a young son of hers who had not yet begun eating solid food. He urinated on him, so the Prophet called for water and sprinkled it over him.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5694, book 76, باب أَىَّ سَاعَةٍ يَحْتَجِمُ وَاحْتَجَمَ أَبُو مُوسَى لَيْلاً
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مَعْمَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ احْتَجَمَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهْوَ صَائِمٌ‏.‏
en_text: Abu Mamar narrated to us; Abd al-Warith narrated to us; Ayyub narrated to us, from Ikrimah, from Ibn Abbas, who said: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, had cupping performed while fasting.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5695, book 76, باب الْحَجْمِ فِي السَّفَرِ وَالإِحْرَامِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، وَعَطَاءٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ احْتَجَمَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهْوَ مُحْرِمٌ‏.‏
en_text: Musaddad narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from Amr, from Tawus and Ata, from Ibn Abbas, who said: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, had cupping performed while in ihram.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5696, book 76, باب الْحِجَامَةِ مِنَ الدَّاءِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُقَاتِلٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا حُمَيْدٌ الطَّوِيلُ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّهُ سُئِلَ عَنْ أَجْرِ الْحَجَّامِ، فَقَالَ احْتَجَمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَجَمَهُ أَبُو طَيْبَةَ، وَأَعْطَاهُ صَاعَيْنِ مِنْ طَعَامٍ، وَكَلَّمَ مَوَالِيَهُ فَخَفَّفُوا عَنْهُ، وَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ أَمْثَلَ مَا تَدَاوَيْتُمْ بِهِ الْحِجَامَةُ وَالْقُسْطُ الْبَحْرِيُّ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ تُعَذِّبُوا صِبْيَانَكُمْ بِالْغَمْزِ مِنَ الْعُذْرَةِ، وَعَلَيْكُمْ بِالْقُسْطِ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn Muqatil narrated to us; Abdullah informed us; Humayd al-Tawil informed us, from Anas, may Allah be pleased with him, who was asked about the cupper's payment. He said: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, had cupping performed; Abu Taybah did it for him, and he gave him two measures of food. He spoke to his masters, who reduced what he owed them. He said: “The best remedies you use are cupping and Indian costus.” He also said: “Do not treat your children by pressing their uvulas; use costus.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5697, book 76, باب الْحِجَامَةِ مِنَ الدَّاءِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ تَلِيدٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرٌو، وَغَيْرُهُ، أَنَّ بُكَيْرًا، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ عَاصِمَ بْنَ عُمَرَ بْنِ قَتَادَةَ حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ عَادَ الْمُقَنَّعَ ثُمَّ قَالَ لاَ أَبْرَحُ حَتَّى تَحْتَجِمَ فَإِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ إِنَّ فِيهِ شِفَاءً ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Said ibn Talid narrated to us, saying: Ibn Wahb narrated to me, saying: Amr and another person informed me that Bukayr narrated to him that Asim ibn Umar ibn Qatadah narrated to him that Jabir ibn Abdullah, may Allah be pleased with them both, visited al-Muqanna. He then said: “I will not leave until you have cupping performed, for I heard the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, say: ‘There is healing in it.’”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5698, 5699, book 76, باب الْحِجَامَةِ عَلَى الرَّأْسِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي سُلَيْمَانُ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ الأَعْرَجَ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ ابْنَ بُحَيْنَةَ، يُحَدِّثُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم احْتَجَمَ بِلَحْىِ جَمَلٍ مِنْ طَرِيقِ مَكَّةَ، وَهْوَ مُحْرِمٌ، فِي وَسَطِ رَأْسِهِ‏.‏ وَقَالَ الأَنْصَارِيُّ أَخْبَرَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ حَسَّانَ، حَدَّثَنَا عِكْرِمَةُ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم احْتَجَمَ فِي رَأْسِهِ‏.‏
en_text: Ismail narrated to us: Sulayman narrated to me, from Alqamah, who heard Abd al-Rahman al-Araj, who heard Abdullah ibn Buhaynah relate that the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, had cupping performed at Lahy Jamal, on the road to Mecca, while in ihram, on the middle of his head. Al-Ansari said: Hisham ibn Hassan informed us; Ikrimah narrated to us, from Ibn Abbas, may Allah be pleased with them both, that the Messenger of Allah had cupping performed on his head.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5700, 5701, book 76, باب الْحَجْمِ مِنَ الشَّقِيقَةِ وَالصُّدَاعِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، احْتَجَمَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي رَأْسِهِ وَهْوَ مُحْرِمٌ مِنْ وَجَعٍ كَانَ بِهِ بِمَاءٍ يُقَالُ لَهُ لَحْىُ جَمَلٍ‏.‏ وَقَالَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَوَاءٍ أَخْبَرَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم احْتَجَمَ وَهْوَ مُحْرِمٌ فِي رَأْسِهِ مِنْ شَقِيقَةٍ كَانَتْ بِهِ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn Bashshar narrated to me; Ibn Abi Adi narrated to us, from Hisham, from Ikrimah, from Ibn Abbas: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, had cupping performed on his head while in ihram, because of an ailment he had, at a place called Lahy Jamal. Muhammad ibn Sawa said: Hisham informed us, from Ikrimah, from Ibn Abbas, that the Messenger of Allah had cupping performed on his head while in ihram because of a migraine he had.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5702, book 76, باب الْحَجْمِ مِنَ الشَّقِيقَةِ وَالصُّدَاعِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أَبَانَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْغَسِيلِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَاصِمُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ إِنْ كَانَ فِي شَىْءٍ مِنْ أَدْوِيَتِكُمْ خَيْرٌ فَفِي شَرْبَةِ عَسَلٍ أَوْ شَرْطَةِ مِحْجَمٍ أَوْ لَذْعَةٍ مِنْ نَارٍ، وَمَا أُحِبُّ أَنْ أَكْتَوِيَ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Ismail ibn Aban narrated to us; Ibn al-Ghasil narrated to us, saying: Asim ibn Umar narrated to me, from Jabir ibn Abdullah, who said: I heard the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, say: “If there is healing in any of your remedies, it is in a drink of honey, the incision of cupping, or a cauterizing touch with fire. I do not like to be cauterized.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5703, book 76, باب الْحَلْقِ مِنَ الأَذَى
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مُجَاهِدًا، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، عَنْ كَعْبٍ، هُوَ ابْنُ عُجْرَةَ قَالَ أَتَى عَلَىَّ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم زَمَنَ الْحُدَيْبِيَةِ، وَأَنَا أُوقِدُ تَحْتَ بُرْمَةٍ، وَالْقَمْلُ يَتَنَاثَرُ عَنْ رَأْسِي فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَيُؤْذِيكَ هَوَامُّكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ نَعَمْ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَاحْلِقْ وَصُمْ ثَلاَثَةَ أَيَّامٍ، أَوْ أَطْعِمْ سِتَّةً، أَوِ انْسُكْ نَسِيكَةً ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ أَيُّوبُ لاَ أَدْرِي بِأَيَّتِهِنَّ بَدَأَ‏.‏
en_text: Musaddad narrated to us; Hammad narrated to us, from Ayyub, who said: I heard Mujahid, from Ibn Abi Layla, from Kab—Ibn Ujrah—who said: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, came to me at the time of al-Hudaybiyah while I was tending a fire beneath a cooking pot and lice were falling from my head. He said: “Are the lice bothering you?” I said: “Yes.” He said: “Shave your head and fast for three days, or feed six needy people, or offer a sacrifice.” Ayyub said: I do not know which of these he mentioned first.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5704, book 76, باب مَنِ اكْتَوَى أَوْ كَوَى غَيْرَهُ، وَفَضْلِ مَنْ لَمْ يَكْتَوِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ، هِشَامُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ الْغَسِيلِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَاصِمُ بْنُ عُمَرَ بْنِ قَتَادَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرًا، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنْ كَانَ فِي شَىْءٍ مِنْ أَدْوِيَتِكُمْ شِفَاءٌ فَفِي شَرْطَةِ مِحْجَمٍ أَوْ لَذْعَةٍ بِنَارٍ، وَمَا أُحِبُّ أَنْ أَكْتَوِيَ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Abu al-Walid Hisham ibn Abd al-Malik narrated to us; Abd al-Rahman ibn Sulayman ibn al-Ghasil narrated to us; Asim ibn Umar ibn Qatadah narrated to us, saying: I heard Jabir narrate from the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, who said: “If any of your remedies brings healing, it is in the incision of cupping or a cauterizing touch with fire. I do not like to be cauterized.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5705, book 76, باب مَنِ اكْتَوَى أَوْ كَوَى غَيْرَهُ، وَفَضْلِ مَنْ لَمْ يَكْتَوِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عِمْرَانُ بْنُ مَيْسَرَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حُصَيْنٌ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ، عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ حُصَيْنٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ لاَ رُقْيَةَ إِلاَّ مِنْ عَيْنٍ أَوْ حُمَةٍ‏.‏ فَذَكَرْتُهُ لِسَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ فَقَالَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ عُرِضَتْ عَلَىَّ الأُمَمُ، فَجَعَلَ النَّبِيُّ وَالنَّبِيَّانِ يَمُرُّونَ مَعَهُمُ الرَّهْطُ، وَالنَّبِيُّ لَيْسَ مَعَهُ أَحَدٌ، حَتَّى رُفِعَ لِي سَوَادٌ عَظِيمٌ، قُلْتُ مَا هَذَا أُمَّتِي هَذِهِ قِيلَ هَذَا مُوسَى وَقَوْمُهُ‏.‏ قِيلَ انْظُرْ إِلَى الأُفُقِ‏.‏ فَإِذَا سَوَادٌ يَمْلأُ الأُفُقَ، ثُمَّ قِيلَ لِي انْظُرْ هَا هُنَا وَهَا هُنَا فِي آفَاقِ السَّمَاءِ فَإِذَا سَوَادٌ قَدْ مَلأَ الأُفُقَ قِيلَ هَذِهِ أُمَّتُكَ وَيَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ مِنْ هَؤُلاَءِ سَبْعُونَ أَلْفًا بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ، ثُمَّ دَخَلَ وَلَمْ يُبَيِّنْ لَهُمْ فَأَفَاضَ الْقَوْمُ وَقَالُوا نَحْنُ الَّذِينَ آمَنَّا بِاللَّهِ، وَاتَّبَعْنَا رَسُولَهُ، فَنَحْنُ هُمْ أَوْ أَوْلاَدُنَا الَّذِينَ وُلِدُوا فِي الإِسْلاَمِ فَإِنَّا وُلِدْنَا فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ‏.‏ فَبَلَغَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَخَرَجَ فَقَالَ هُمُ الَّذِينَ لاَ يَسْتَرْقُونَ، وَلاَ يَتَطَيَّرُونَ، وَلاَ يَكْتَوُونَ وَعَلَى رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ عُكَّاشَةُ بْنُ مِحْصَنٍ أَمِنْهُمْ أَنَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ نَعَمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَامَ آخَرُ فَقَالَ أَمِنْهُمْ أَنَا قَالَ ‏"‏ سَبَقَكَ عُكَّاشَةُ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Imran ibn Maysarah narrated to us; Ibn Fudayl narrated to us; Husayn narrated to us, from Amir, from Imran ibn Husayn, may Allah be pleased with them both, who said: “No incantation is [especially warranted] except for the evil eye or a venomous sting.” I mentioned this to Said ibn Jubayr, and he said: Ibn Abbas narrated to us that the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said: “The nations were shown to me. A prophet and two prophets passed by with small groups, and a prophet passed by with no one. Then a great multitude was raised up before me. I said: ‘Is this my community?’ It was said: ‘This is Moses and his people.’ Then I was told: ‘Look toward the horizon.’ There was a multitude filling it. I was told: ‘Look here and there at the horizons of the sky.’ There was a multitude filling them. It was said: ‘This is your community, and seventy thousand of them will enter Paradise without reckoning.’” Then he went inside without explaining further. The people discussed it, saying: “We believed in Allah and followed His Messenger, so perhaps we are they—or our children born in Islam. We were born in the pre-Islamic age.” The Prophet heard of this, came out, and said: “They are those who do not ask others to perform incantations for them, do not regard omens as bad, do not seek cauterization, and put their trust in their Lord.” Ukkashah ibn Mihsan said: “Am I one of them, Messenger of Allah?” He said: “Yes.” Another man stood and asked the same. He said: “Ukkashah has preceded you.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5706, book 76, باب الإِثْمِدِ وَالْكُحْلِ مِنَ الرَّمَدِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي حُمَيْدُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ زَيْنَبَ، عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ أَنَّ امْرَأَةً تُوُفِّيَ زَوْجُهَا فَاشْتَكَتْ عَيْنَهَا، فَذَكَرُوهَا لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَذَكَرُوا لَهُ الْكُحْلَ، وَأَنَّهُ يُخَافُ عَلَى عَيْنِهَا، فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لَقَدْ كَانَتْ إِحْدَاكُنَّ تَمْكُثُ فِي بَيْتِهَا فِي شَرِّ أَحْلاَسِهَا ـ أَوْ فِي أَحْلاَسِهَا فِي شَرِّ بَيْتِهَا ـ فَإِذَا مَرَّ كَلْبٌ رَمَتْ بَعْرَةً، فَلاَ، أَرْبَعَةَ أَشْهُرٍ وَعَشْرًا ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Musaddad narrated to us; Yahya narrated to us, from Shu'bah, who said: Humayd ibn Nafi narrated to me, from Zaynab, from Umm Salamah, may Allah be pleased with her: A woman's husband died, and her eye became sore. They mentioned her condition and the use of kohl to the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, and said they feared for her eye. He said: “One of you used to remain in her house in the worst of her worn furnishings—or in her worn furnishings in the worst of her house—and when a dog passed, she would throw a piece of dung. No: [the waiting period is] four months and ten days.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5707, book 76, باب الْجُذَامِ
text_original: وَقَالَ عَفَّانُ حَدَّثَنَا سَلِيمُ بْنُ حَيَّانَ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ مِينَاءَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لاَ عَدْوَى وَلاَ طِيَرَةَ وَلاَ هَامَةَ وَلاَ صَفَرَ، وَفِرَّ مِنَ الْمَجْذُومِ كَمَا تَفِرُّ مِنَ الأَسَدِ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Affan said: Sulaym ibn Hayyan narrated to us; Said ibn Mina narrated to us, who said: I heard Abu Hurairah say: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said: “There is no contagion [that operates independently], no belief in the ominous month of Safar, no bird-omen, and no Hamah omen. Flee from a leper as you would flee from a lion.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5708, book 76, باب الْمَنُّ شِفَاءٌ لِلْعَيْنِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ، سَمِعْتُ عَمْرَو بْنَ حُرَيْثٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ سَعِيدَ بْنَ زَيْدٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ الْكَمْأَةُ مِنَ الْمَنِّ، وَمَاؤُهَا شِفَاءٌ لِلْعَيْنِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ شُعْبَةُ وَأَخْبَرَنِي الْحَكَمُ بْنُ عُتَيْبَةَ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ الْعُرَنِيِّ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ حُرَيْثٍ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ قَالَ شُعْبَةُ لَمَّا حَدَّثَنِي بِهِ الْحَكَمُ لَمْ أُنْكِرْهُ مِنْ حَدِيثِ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna narrated to us; Ghundar narrated to us; Shu'bah narrated to us, from Abd al-Malik, who said: I heard Amr ibn Hurayth say: I heard Said ibn Zayd say: I heard the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, say: “Truffles are a kind of manna, and their juice is a cure for the eye.” Shu'bah said: Al-Hakam ibn Utaybah informed me, from al-Hasan al-Urani, from Amr ibn Hurayth, from Said ibn Zayd, from the Prophet, the same report. Shu'bah said: When al-Hakam narrated it to me, I did not doubt that it was the report of Abd al-Malik.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5709-5712, book 76, باب اللَّدُودِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مُوسَى بْنُ أَبِي عَائِشَةَ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، وَعَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَبَّلَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهْوَ مَيِّتٌ‏.‏ قَالَ وَقَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ لَدَدْنَاهُ فِي مَرَضِهِ، فَجَعَلَ يُشِيرُ إِلَيْنَا، أَنْ لاَ تَلُدُّونِي‏.‏ فَقُلْنَا كَرَاهِيَةُ الْمَرِيضِ لِلدَّوَاءِ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا أَفَاقَ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَلَمْ أَنْهَكُمْ أَنْ تَلُدُّونِي ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْنَا كَرَاهِيَةَ الْمَرِيضِ لِلدَّوَاءِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ يَبْقَى فِي الْبَيْتِ أَحَدٌ إِلاَّ لُدَّ ـ وَأَنَا أَنْظُرُ ـ إِلاَّ الْعَبَّاسَ فَإِنَّهُ لَمْ يَشْهَدْكُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Ali ibn Abdullah narrated to us; Yahya ibn Said narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, saying: Musa ibn Abi Aishah narrated to me, from Ubaydullah ibn Abdullah, from Ibn Abbas and Aishah, that Abu Bakr, may Allah be pleased with him, kissed the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, after he had died. Aishah said: We administered medicine into his mouth during his illness, and he gestured to us not to do so. We said: “A sick person dislikes medicine.” When he recovered, he said: “Did I not forbid you to administer medicine into my mouth?” We said: “A sick person dislikes medicine.” He said: “Let no one in the house remain without having medicine administered into his mouth while I watch, except al-Abbas, for he was not present with you.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5713, book 76, باب اللَّدُودِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، أَخْبَرَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أُمِّ قَيْسٍ، قَالَتْ دَخَلْتُ بِابْنٍ لِي عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَقَدْ أَعْلَقْتُ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الْعُذْرَةِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ عَلَى مَا تَدْغَرْنَ أَوْلاَدَكُنَّ بِهَذَا الْعِلاَقِ عَلَيْكُنَّ بِهَذَا الْعُودِ الْهِنْدِيِّ، فَإِنَّ فِيهِ سَبْعَةَ أَشْفِيَةٍ، مِنْهَا ذَاتُ الْجَنْبِ يُسْعَطُ مِنَ الْعُذْرَةِ، وَيُلَدُّ مِنْ ذَاتِ الْجَنْبِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَسَمِعْتُ الزُّهْرِيَّ يَقُولُ بَيَّنَ لَنَا اثْنَيْنِ وَلَمْ يُبَيِّنْ لَنَا خَمْسَةً‏.‏ قُلْتُ لِسُفْيَانَ فَإِنَّ مَعْمَرًا يَقُولُ أَعْلَقْتُ عَلَيْهِ‏.‏ قَالَ لَمْ يَحْفَظْ أَعْلَقْتُ عَنْهُ، حَفِظْتُهُ مِنْ فِي الزُّهْرِيِّ‏.‏ وَوَصَفَ سُفْيَانُ الْغُلاَمَ يُحَنَّكُ بِالإِصْبَعِ وَأَدْخَلَ سُفْيَانُ فِي حَنَكِهِ، إِنَّمَا يَعْنِي رَفْعَ حَنَكِهِ بِإِصْبَعِهِ، وَلَمْ يَقُلْ أَعْلِقُوا عَنْهُ شَيْئًا‏.‏
en_text: Ali ibn Abdullah narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from al-Zuhri, who said: Ubaydullah informed me, from Umm Qays, who said: I brought a son of mine to the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, after I had treated his tonsillitis by pressing his uvula. He said: “Why do you press your children's uvulas with this treatment? Use Indian wood, for it contains seven remedies, including pleurisy. It is used as nasal medicine for tonsillitis and administered into the side of the mouth for pleurisy.” I heard al-Zuhri say: He explained two of them to us and did not explain five. I said to Sufyan: “Mamar says, ‘I treated him.’” He replied: “He did not preserve the wording ‘I treated him’ from him; I preserved it directly from al-Zuhri.” Sufyan described the boy as having his palate lifted with a finger; Sufyan put his finger into the boy's mouth and explained that it meant lifting his palate with his finger. He did not say to administer anything into his mouth.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5714, book 76, كتاب الطب
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، وَيُونُسُ، قَالَ الزُّهْرِيُّ أَخْبَرَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَتْ لَمَّا ثَقُلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَاشْتَدَّ وَجَعُهُ، اسْتَأْذَنَ أَزْوَاجَهُ فِي أَنْ يُمَرَّضَ فِي بَيْتِي، فَأَذِنَّ، فَخَرَجَ بَيْنَ رَجُلَيْنِ، تَخُطُّ رِجْلاَهُ فِي الأَرْضِ بَيْنَ عَبَّاسٍ وَآخَرَ‏.‏ فَأَخْبَرْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ هَلْ تَدْرِي مَنِ الرَّجُلُ الآخَرُ الَّذِي لَمْ تُسَمِّ عَائِشَةُ قُلْتُ لاَ‏.‏ قَالَ هُوَ عَلِيٌّ‏.‏ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعْدَ مَا دَخَلَ بَيْتَهَا وَاشْتَدَّ بِهِ وَجَعُهُ ‏"‏ هَرِيقُوا عَلَىَّ مِنْ سَبْعِ قِرَبٍ لَمْ تُحْلَلْ أَوْكِيَتُهُنَّ، لَعَلِّي أَعْهَدُ إِلَى النَّاسِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَأَجْلَسْنَاهُ فِي مِخْضَبٍ لِحَفْصَةَ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ طَفِقْنَا نَصُبُّ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ تِلْكَ الْقِرَبِ، حَتَّى جَعَلَ يُشِيرُ إِلَيْنَا أَنْ قَدْ فَعَلْتُنَّ‏.‏ قَالَتْ وَخَرَجَ إِلَى النَّاسِ فَصَلَّى لَهُمْ وَخَطَبَهُمْ‏.‏
en_text: Bishr ibn Muhammad informed us; Abdullah informed us; Mamar and Yunus informed us. Al-Zuhri said: Ubaydullah ibn Abdullah ibn Utbah informed me that Aishah, may Allah be pleased with her, the wife of the Prophet, said: When the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, became very ill, he asked his wives for permission to be cared for in my house. They permitted him. He came out supported by two men, his feet dragging on the ground, between al-Abbas and another man. I told Ibn Abbas, who asked: “Do you know who the other man was, whom Aishah did not name?” I said: “No.” He said: “It was Ali.” Aishah said: After the Prophet entered her house and his illness became severe, he said: “Pour water over me from seven waterskins whose ties have not been undone, so that I may address the people.” They seated him in a basin belonging to Hafsah, the Prophet's wife, and began pouring water from those waterskins over him until he gestured that they had done enough. She said: He went out to the people, led them in prayer, and addressed them.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5715, book 76, باب الْعُذْرَةِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ أُمَّ قَيْسٍ بِنْتَ مِحْصَنٍ الأَسَدِيَّةَ ـ أَسَدَ خُزَيْمَةَ، وَكَانَتْ مِنَ الْمُهَاجِرَاتِ الأُوَلِ اللاَّتِي بَايَعْنَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهْىَ أُخْتُ عُكَّاشَةَ ـ أَخْبَرَتْهُ أَنَّهَا أَتَتْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِابْنٍ لَهَا، قَدْ أَعْلَقَتْ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الْعُذْرَةِ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ عَلَى مَا تَدْغَرْنَ أَوْلاَدَكُنَّ بِهَذَا الْعِلاَقِ عَلَيْكُمْ بِهَذَا الْعُودِ الْهِنْدِيِّ، فَإِنَّ فِيهِ سَبْعَةَ أَشْفِيَةٍ مِنْهَا ذَاتُ الْجَنْبِ ‏"‏‏.‏ يُرِيدُ الْكُسْتَ، وَهْوَ الْعُودُ الْهِنْدِيُّ‏.‏ وَقَالَ يُونُسُ وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ رَاشِدٍ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَلَّقَتْ عَلَيْهِ‏.‏
en_text: Abu al-Yaman narrated to us; Shuayb informed us, from al-Zuhri, who said: Ubaydullah ibn Abdullah informed me that Umm Qays bint Mihsan al-Asadiyyah—of Asad of Khuzaymah, one of the first emigrant women to pledge allegiance to the Prophet, and the sister of Ukkashah—informed him that she brought a son of hers to the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, after treating him for tonsillitis by pressing his uvula. The Prophet said: “Why do you press your children’s uvulas with this treatment? Use Indian wood, for it contains seven remedies, including pleurisy.” He meant costus, which is Indian wood. Yunus and Ishaq ibn Rashid reported from al-Zuhri the wording: “She treated him.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5716, book 76, باب دَوَاءِ الْمَبْطُونِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الْمُتَوَكِّلِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ إِنَّ أَخِي اسْتَطْلَقَ بَطْنُهُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اسْقِهِ عَسَلاً ‏"‏‏.‏ فَسَقَاهُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ إِنِّي سَقَيْتُهُ فَلَمْ يَزِدْهُ إِلاَّ اسْتِطْلاَقًا‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ صَدَقَ اللَّهُ وَكَذَبَ بَطْنُ أَخِيكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ النَّضْرُ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn Bashshar narrated to us; Muhammad ibn Jafar narrated to us; Shu'bah narrated to us, from Qatadah, from Abu al-Mutawakkil, from Abu Said, who said: A man came to the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, and said: “My brother has severe diarrhea.” He said: “Give him honey to drink.” The man gave it to him, then said: “I gave it to him, but it only made his diarrhea worse.” He said: “Allah has spoken the truth, but your brother's stomach has lied.” Al-Nadr also reported it from Shu'bah.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5717, book 76, باب لاَ صَفَرَ، وَهْوَ دَاءٌ يَأْخُذُ الْبَطْنَ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ صَالِحٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، وَغَيْرُهُ، أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ عَدْوَى وَلاَ صَفَرَ وَلاَ هَامَةَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَعْرَابِيٌّ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فَمَا بَالُ إِبِلِي تَكُونُ فِي الرَّمْلِ كَأَنَّهَا الظِّبَاءُ فَيَأْتِي الْبَعِيرُ الأَجْرَبُ فَيَدْخُلُ بَيْنَهَا فَيُجْرِبُهَا‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ فَمَنْ أَعْدَى الأَوَّلَ ‏"‏‏.‏ رَوَاهُ الزُّهْرِيُّ عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ وَسِنَانِ بْنِ أَبِي سِنَانٍ‏.‏
en_text: Abd al-Aziz ibn Abdullah narrated to us; Ibrahim ibn Sad narrated to us, from Salih, from Ibn Shihab, who said: Abu Salamah ibn Abd al-Rahman and another person informed me that Abu Hurairah, may Allah be pleased with him, said: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said: “There is no contagion [that operates independently], no belief in the ominous month of Safar, and no bird-omen.” A Bedouin said: “Messenger of Allah, what about my camels? They are like gazelles in the sand, then a mangy camel comes among them and makes them mange.” He said: “Then who infected the first one?” Al-Zuhri reported it from Abu Salamah and Sinan ibn Abi Sinan.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5718, book 76, باب ذَاتِ الْجَنْبِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَتَّابُ بْنُ بَشِيرٍ، عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ أُمَّ قَيْسٍ بِنْتَ مِحْصَنٍ،، وَكَانَتْ، مِنَ الْمُهَاجِرَاتِ الأُوَلِ اللاَّتِي بَايَعْنَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهْىَ أُخْتُ عُكَّاشَةَ بْنِ مِحْصَنٍ أَخْبَرَتْهُ أَنَّهَا أَتَتْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِابْنٍ لَهَا قَدْ عَلَّقَتْ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الْعُذْرَةِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ، عَلَى مَا تَدْغَرُونَ أَوْلاَدَكُمْ بِهَذِهِ الأَعْلاَقِ عَلَيْكُمْ بِهَذَا الْعُودِ الْهِنْدِيِّ، فَإِنَّ فِيهِ سَبْعَةَ أَشْفِيَةٍ، مِنْهَا ذَاتُ الْجَنْبِ ‏"‏‏.‏ يُرِيدُ الْكُسْتَ يَعْنِي الْقُسْطَ، قَالَ وَهْىَ لُغَةٌ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad narrated to me; Attab ibn Bashir informed us, from Ishaq, from al-Zuhri, who said: Ubaydullah ibn Abdullah informed me that Umm Qays bint Mihsan, one of the first women to emigrate and pledge allegiance to the Messenger of Allah, and sister of Ukkashah ibn Mihsan, informed him that she brought a son of hers to the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, after treating him for tonsillitis by pressing his uvula. He said: “Fear Allah! Why do you press your children's uvulas with these treatments? Use Indian wood, for it contains seven remedies, including pleurisy.” He meant costus, meaning al-qust; this is a dialectal form.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5719, 5720, 5721, book 76, باب ذَاتِ الْجَنْبِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عَارِمٌ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، قَالَ قُرِئَ عَلَى أَيُّوبَ مِنْ كُتُبِ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ، مِنْهُ مَا حَدَّثَ بِهِ وَمِنْهُ مَا قُرِئَ عَلَيْهِ، وَكَانَ هَذَا فِي الْكِتَابِ عَنْ أَنَسٍ أَنَّ أَبَا طَلْحَةَ وَأَنَسَ بْنَ النَّضْرِ كَوَيَاهُ، وَكَوَاهُ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ بِيَدِهِ‏.‏ وَقَالَ عَبَّادُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ أَذِنَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لأَهْلِ بَيْتٍ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ أَنْ يَرْقُوا مِنَ الْحُمَةِ وَالأُذُنِ‏.‏ قَالَ أَنَسٌ كُوِيتُ مِنْ ذَاتِ الْجَنْبِ وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَىٌّ، وَشَهِدَنِي أَبُو طَلْحَةَ وَأَنَسُ بْنُ النَّضْرِ وَزَيْدُ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ، وَأَبُو طَلْحَةَ كَوَانِي‏.‏
en_text: Arim narrated to us; Hammad narrated to us, saying: Some of the books of Abu Qilabah were read to Ayyub; some reports in them he had narrated and some were read to him. This was written in the book from Anas: Abu Talhah and Anas ibn al-Nadr cauterized him, and Abu Talhah cauterized him with his own hand. Abbad ibn Mansur reported from Ayyub, from Abu Qilabah, from Anas ibn Malik, who said: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, permitted a household from the Ansar to use incantations for a venomous sting and an ear ailment. Anas said: I was cauterized for pleurisy while the Messenger of Allah was alive. Abu Talhah, Anas ibn al-Nadr, and Zayd ibn Thabit witnessed it, and Abu Talhah cauterized me.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5722, book 76, باب حَرْقِ الْحَصِيرِ لِيُسَدَّ بِهِ الدَّمُ
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ عُفَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْقَارِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ السَّاعِدِيِّ، قَالَ لَمَّا كُسِرَتْ عَلَى رَأْسِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْبَيْضَةُ، وَأُدْمِيَ وَجْهُهُ، وَكُسِرَتْ رَبَاعِيَتُهُ، وَكَانَ عَلِيٌّ يَخْتَلِفُ بِالْمَاءِ فِي الْمِجَنِّ، وَجَاءَتْ فَاطِمَةُ تَغْسِلُ عَنْ وَجْهِهِ الدَّمَ، فَلَمَّا رَأَتْ فَاطِمَةُ ـ عَلَيْهَا السَّلاَمُ ـ الدَّمَ يَزِيدُ عَلَى الْمَاءِ كَثْرَةً عَمَدَتْ إِلَى حَصِيرٍ فَأَحْرَقَتْهَا وَأَلْصَقَتْهَا عَلَى جُرْحِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَرَقَأَ الدَّمُ‏.‏
en_text: Said ibn Ufair narrated to me; Yaqoub ibn Abd al-Rahman al-Qari narrated to us, from Abu Hazim, from Sahl ibn Sad al-Saidi, who said: When the helmet was broken on the head of the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, his face was bloodied, and one of his front teeth was broken, Ali kept bringing water in a shield. Fatimah came and washed the blood from his face. When Fatimah, peace be upon her, saw that the blood exceeded the water, she took a mat, burned it, and placed it on the wound of the Messenger of Allah. The bleeding stopped.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5723, book 76, باب الْحُمَّى مِنْ فَيْحِ جَهَنَّمَ
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ الْحُمَّى مِنْ فَيْحِ جَهَنَّمَ فَأَطْفِئُوهَا بِالْمَاءِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ نَافِعٌ وَكَانَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ يَقُولُ اكْشِفْ عَنَّا الرِّجْزَ‏.‏
en_text: Yahya ibn Sulayman narrated to me; Ibn Wahb narrated to me, saying: Malik narrated to me, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar, may Allah be pleased with them both, from the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, who said: “Fever is from the breath of Hell, so cool it with water.” Nafi said: Abdullah used to say: “Remove the affliction from us.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5724, book 76, باب الْحُمَّى مِنْ فَيْحِ جَهَنَّمَ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتِ الْمُنْذِرِ، أَنَّ أَسْمَاءَ بِنْتَ أَبِي بَكْرٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ كَانَتْ إِذَا أُتِيَتْ بِالْمَرْأَةِ قَدْ حُمَّتْ تَدْعُو لَهَا، أَخَذَتِ الْمَاءَ فَصَبَّتْهُ بَيْنَهَا وَبَيْنَ جَيْبِهَا قَالَتْ وَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَأْمُرُنَا أَنْ نَبْرُدَهَا بِالْمَاءِ‏.‏
en_text: Abdullah ibn Maslamah narrated to us, from Malik, from Hisham, from Fatimah bint al-Mundhir, that Asma bint Abi Bakr, may Allah be pleased with them both, when a woman with fever was brought to her, would pray for her and take water and pour it between her and the opening of her garment. She said: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, used to instruct us to cool fever with water.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5974, book 78, باب إِجَابَةِ دُعَاءِ مَنْ بَرَّ وَالِدَيْهِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عُقْبَةَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي نَافِعٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ بَيْنَمَا ثَلاَثَةُ نَفَرٍ يَتَمَاشَوْنَ أَخَذَهُمُ الْمَطَرُ، فَمَالُوا إِلَى غَارٍ فِي الْجَبَلِ، فَانْحَطَّتْ عَلَى فَمِ غَارِهِمْ صَخْرَةٌ مِنَ الْجَبَلِ، فَأَطْبَقَتْ عَلَيْهِمْ، فَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ لِبَعْضٍ انْظُرُوا أَعْمَالاً عَمِلْتُمُوهَا لِلَّهِ صَالِحَةً، فَادْعُوا اللَّهَ بِهَا لَعَلَّهُ يَفْرُجُهَا‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَحَدُهُمُ اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّهُ كَانَ لِي وَالِدَانِ شَيْخَانِ كَبِيرَانِ، وَلِي صِبْيَةٌ صِغَارٌ كُنْتُ أَرْعَى عَلَيْهِمْ، فَإِذَا رُحْتُ عَلَيْهِمْ فَحَلَبْتُ بَدَأْتُ بِوَالِدَىَّ أَسْقِيهِمَا قَبْلَ وَلَدِي، وَإِنَّهُ نَاءَ بِيَ الشَّجَرُ فَمَا أَتَيْتُ حَتَّى أَمْسَيْتُ، فَوَجَدْتُهُمَا قَدْ نَامَا، فَحَلَبْتُ كَمَا كُنْتُ أَحْلُبُ، فَجِئْتُ بِالْحِلاَبِ فَقُمْتُ عِنْدَ رُءُوسِهِمَا، أَكْرَهُ أَنْ أُوقِظَهُمَا مِنْ نَوْمِهِمَا، وَأَكْرَهُ أَنْ أَبْدَأَ بِالصِّبْيَةِ قَبْلَهُمَا، وَالصِّبْيَةُ يَتَضَاغَوْنَ عِنْدَ قَدَمَىَّ، فَلَمْ يَزَلْ ذَلِكَ دَأْبِي وَدَأْبَهُمْ حَتَّى طَلَعَ الْفَجْرُ، فَإِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنِّي فَعَلْتُ ذَلِكَ ابْتِغَاءَ وَجْهِكَ، فَافْرُجْ لَنَا فُرْجَةً نَرَى مِنْهَا السَّمَاءَ، فَفَرَجَ اللَّهُ لَهُمْ فُرْجَةً حَتَّى يَرَوْنَ مِنْهَا السَّمَاءَ‏.‏ وَقَالَ الثَّانِي اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّهُ كَانَتْ لِي ابْنَةُ عَمٍّ، أُحِبُّهَا كَأَشَدِّ مَا يُحِبُّ الرِّجَالُ النِّسَاءَ، فَطَلَبْتُ إِلَيْهَا نَفْسَهَا، فَأَبَتْ حَتَّى آتِيَهَا بِمِائَةِ دِينَارٍ، فَسَعَيْتُ حَتَّى جَمَعْتُ مِائَةَ دِينَارٍ، فَلَقِيتُهَا بِهَا، فَلَمَّا قَعَدْتُ بَيْنَ رِجْلَيْهَا قَالَتْ يَا عَبْدَ اللَّهِ اتَّقِ اللَّهَ، وَلاَ تَفْتَحِ الْخَاتَمَ‏.‏ فَقُمْتُ عَنْهَا، اللَّهُمَّ فَإِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنِّي قَدْ فَعَلْتُ ذَلِكَ ابْتِغَاءَ وَجْهِكَ فَافْرُجْ لَنَا مِنْهَا فَفَرَجَ لَهُمْ فُرْجَةً‏.‏ وَقَالَ الآخَرُ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي كُنْتُ اسْتَأْجَرْتُ أَجِيرًا بِفَرَقِ أَرُزٍّ فَلَمَّا قَضَى عَمَلَهُ قَالَ أَعْطِنِي حَقِّي‏.‏ فَعَرَضْتُ عَلَيْهِ حَقَّهُ، فَتَرَكَهُ وَرَغِبَ عَنْهُ، فَلَمْ أَزَلْ أَزْرَعُهُ حَتَّى جَمَعْتُ مِنْهُ بَقَرًا وَرَاعِيَهَا، فَجَاءَنِي فَقَالَ اتَّقِ اللَّهَ وَلاَ تَظْلِمْنِي، وَأَعْطِنِي حَقِّي‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ اذْهَبْ إِلَى ذَلِكَ الْبَقَرِ وَرَاعِيهَا‏.‏ فَقَالَ اتَّقِ اللَّهَ وَلاَ تَهْزَأْ بِي‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ إِنِّي لاَ أَهْزَأُ بِكَ، فَخُذْ ذَلِكَ الْبَقَرَ وَرَاعِيَهَا‏.‏ فَأَخَذَهُ فَانْطَلَقَ بِهَا، فَإِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنِّي فَعَلْتُ ذَلِكَ ابْتِغَاءَ وَجْهِكَ، فَافْرُجْ مَا بَقِيَ، فَفَرَجَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Said ibn Abi Maryam narrated to us; Ismail ibn Ibrahim ibn Uqbah narrated to us, saying: Nafi informed me, from Ibn Umar, may Allah be pleased with them both, from the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, who said: “While three men were walking, rain caught them, so they took shelter in a cave in a mountain. A rock slid down from the mountain and blocked the cave entrance. They said to one another: ‘Consider righteous deeds you did for Allah, and call upon Allah by them; perhaps He will remove this rock.’ One of them said: ‘O Allah, I had two elderly parents and young children whom I supported. When I returned in the evening and milked the animals, I would give my parents to drink before my children. One day I went far in search of trees and did not return until evening. I found them asleep. I milked as usual and stood by their heads with the milk, unwilling to wake them and unwilling to give my children theirs first. My children were crying at my feet. That remained my practice and theirs until dawn. If You know I did that seeking Your pleasure, open an opening for us through which we may see the sky.’ Allah opened an opening for them through which they could see the sky. The second man said: ‘O Allah, I had a female cousin whom I loved more than men love women. I sought intimacy with her, but she refused until I gave her one hundred dinars. I worked until I gathered one hundred dinars and brought them to her. When I sat between her legs, she said: “Servant of Allah, fear Allah and do not break the seal [of chastity].” So I left her. O Allah, if You know I did that seeking Your pleasure, open another part for us.’ Allah opened another part for them. The third man said: ‘O Allah, I hired a worker for a measure of rice. When he finished his work, he said: “Give me my due.” I offered him his wage, but he left it and turned away from it. I kept investing it until it grew into cattle and their herder. He later came and said: “Fear Allah and do not wrong me; give me my due.” I said: “Go to those cattle and their herder.” He said: “Fear Allah and do not mock me.” I said: “I am not mocking you; take those cattle and their herder.” He took them and went away. If You know I did that seeking Your pleasure, remove what remains of the obstruction.’ Then Allah removed it all for them.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5975, book 78, باب عُقُوقُ الْوَالِدَيْنِ مِنَ الْكَبَائِرِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعْدُ بْنُ حَفْصٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ وَرَّادٍ، عَنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ حَرَّمَ عَلَيْكُمْ عُقُوقَ الأُمَّهَاتِ، وَمَنْعَ وَهَاتِ، وَوَأْدَ الْبَنَاتِ، وَكَرِهَ لَكُمْ قِيلَ وَقَالَ، وَكَثْرَةَ السُّؤَالِ، وَإِضَاعَةَ الْمَالِ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Sad ibn Hafs narrated to us; Shayban narrated to us, from Mansur, from al-Musayyab, from Warad, from al-Mughirah, from the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, who said: “Allah has forbidden you to disobey mothers, to withhold what is due while demanding what is yours, and to bury daughters alive. He dislikes for you idle talk, excessive questioning, and wasting wealth.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5984, book 78, باب إِثْمِ الْقَاطِعِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ عُقَيْلٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَنَّ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ مُطْعِمٍ، قَالَ إِنَّ جُبَيْرَ بْنَ مُطْعِمٍ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، سَمِعَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ لاَ يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ قَاطِعٌ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Yahya ibn Bukayr narrated to us; al-Layth narrated to us, from Uqayl, from Ibn Shihab, that Muhammad ibn Jubayr ibn Mutim said: Jubayr ibn Mutim informed him that he heard the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, say: “One who severs family ties will not enter Paradise.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5985, book 78, باب مَنْ بُسِطَ لَهُ فِي الرِّزْقِ بِصِلَةِ الرَّحِمِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ الْمُنْذِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مَعْنٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ مَنْ سَرَّهُ أَنْ يُبْسَطَ لَهُ فِي رِزْقِهِ، وَأَنْ يُنْسَأَ لَهُ فِي أَثَرِهِ، فَلْيَصِلْ رَحِمَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Ibrahim ibn al-Mundhir narrated to me; Muhammad ibn Main narrated to us, saying: My father narrated to me, from Said ibn Abi Said, from Abu Hurairah, may Allah be pleased with him, who said: I heard the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, say: “Whoever wishes to have his provision expanded and his life prolonged, let him maintain ties of kinship.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5986, book 78, باب مَنْ بُسِطَ لَهُ فِي الرِّزْقِ بِصِلَةِ الرَّحِمِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ عُقَيْلٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ أَحَبَّ أَنْ يُبْسَطَ لَهُ فِي رِزْقِهِ، وَيُنْسَأَ لَهُ فِي أَثَرِهِ، فَلْيَصِلْ رَحِمَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Yahya ibn Bukayr narrated to us; al-Layth narrated to us, from Uqayl, from Ibn Shihab, who said: Anas ibn Malik informed me that the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said: “Whoever wishes to have his provision expanded and his life prolonged, let him maintain ties of kinship.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5988, book 78, باب مَنْ وَصَلَ وَصَلَهُ اللَّهُ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ الرَّحِمَ سُجْنَةٌ مِنَ الرَّحْمَنِ، فَقَالَ اللَّهُ مَنْ وَصَلَكِ وَصَلْتُهُ، وَمَنْ قَطَعَكِ قَطَعْتُهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Khalid ibn Makhlad narrated to us; Sulayman narrated to us; Abdullah ibn Dinar narrated to us, from Abu Salih, from Abu Hurairah, may Allah be pleased with him, from the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, who said: “The womb is a bond from the Most Merciful. Allah said: Whoever maintains ties with you, I will maintain ties with him; and whoever severs you, I will sever ties with him.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5989, book 78, باب مَنْ وَصَلَ وَصَلَهُ اللَّهُ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلاَلٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ أَبِي مُزَرِّدٍ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ رُومَانَ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ الرَّحِمُ شِجْنَةٌ، فَمَنْ وَصَلَهَا وَصَلْتُهُ، وَمَنْ قَطَعَهَا قَطَعْتُهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Said ibn Abi Maryam narrated to us; Sulayman ibn Bilal narrated to us, saying: Muawiyah ibn Abi Muzarrid informed me, from Yazid ibn Ruman, from Urwah, from Aishah, may Allah be pleased with her, the wife of the Prophet, from the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, who said: “The womb is a branch of kinship. Whoever maintains it, I will maintain ties with him; whoever severs it, I will sever ties with him.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5991, book 78, باب لَيْسَ الْوَاصِلُ بِالْمُكَافِي
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، وَالْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، وَفِطْرٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو ـ وَقَالَ سُفْيَانُ لَمْ يَرْفَعْهُ الأَعْمَشُ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَرَفَعَهُ حَسَنٌ وَفِطْرٌ ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ لَيْسَ الْوَاصِلُ بِالْمُكَافِئِ، وَلَكِنِ الْوَاصِلُ الَّذِي إِذَا قَطَعَتْ رَحِمُهُ وَصَلَهَا ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn Kathir informed us; Sufyan informed us, from al-Amash, al-Hasan ibn Amr, and Fitr, from Mujahid, from Abdullah ibn Amr. Sufyan said: Al-Amash did not attribute it to the Prophet, but al-Hasan and Fitr did. The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said: “The one who truly maintains family ties is not the one who merely reciprocates; rather, the one who truly maintains them is the one who keeps them when his relatives sever them.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5992, book 78, باب مَنْ وَصَلَ رَحِمَهُ فِي الشِّرْكِ ثُمَّ أَسْلَمَ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّ حَكِيمَ بْنَ حِزَامٍ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، قَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَرَأَيْتَ أُمُورًا كُنْتُ أَتَحَنَّثُ بِهَا فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ مِنْ صِلَةٍ وَعَتَاقَةٍ وَصَدَقَةٍ، هَلْ لِي فِيهَا مِنْ أَجْرٍ‏.‏ قَالَ حَكِيمٌ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَسْلَمْتَ عَلَى مَا سَلَفَ مِنْ خَيْرٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَيُقَالُ أَيْضًا عَنْ أَبِي الْيَمَانِ أَتَحَنَّثُ‏.‏ وَقَالَ مَعْمَرٌ وَصَالِحٌ وَابْنُ الْمُسَافِرِ أَتَحَنَّثُ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ إِسْحَاقَ التَّحَنُّثُ التَّبَرُّرُ، وَتَابَعَهُمْ هِشَامٌ عَنْ أَبِيهِ‏.‏
en_text: Abu al-Yaman narrated to us; Shuayb informed us, from al-Zuhri, who said: Urwah ibn al-Zubayr informed me that Hakim ibn Hizam told him: I said, “Messenger of Allah, what about good deeds I used to do in the pre-Islamic age, such as maintaining ties, freeing slaves, and giving charity? Will I be rewarded for them?” Hakim said: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, replied: “You accepted Islam along with the good you had done before.” It is also reported from Abu al-Yaman with the wording “I used to seek goodness.” Mamar, Salih, and Ibn al-Musafir also reported that wording. Ibn Ishaq said that seeking goodness means doing righteous deeds; Hisham also reported it from his father.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5998, book 78, باب رَحْمَةِ الْوَلَدِ وَتَقْبِيلِهِ وَمُعَانَقَتِهِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ جَاءَ أَعْرَابِيٌّ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ تُقَبِّلُونَ الصِّبْيَانَ فَمَا نُقَبِّلُهُمْ‏.‏ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَوَ أَمْلِكُ لَكَ أَنْ نَزَعَ اللَّهُ مِنْ قَلْبِكَ الرَّحْمَةَ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn Yusuf narrated to us; Sufyan narrated to us, from Hisham, from Urwah, from Aishah, may Allah be pleased with her, who said: A Bedouin came to the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, and said: “You kiss children, but we do not kiss them.” The Prophet said: “What can I do for you if Allah has removed mercy from your heart?”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 6000, book 78, باب جَعَلَ اللَّهُ الرَّحْمَةَ مِائَةَ جُزْءٍ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ، أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ جَعَلَ اللَّهُ الرَّحْمَةَ مِائَةَ جُزْءٍ، فَأَمْسَكَ عِنْدَهُ تِسْعَةً وَتِسْعِينَ جُزْءًا، وَأَنْزَلَ فِي الأَرْضِ جُزْءًا وَاحِدًا، فَمِنْ ذَلِكَ الْجُزْءِ يَتَرَاحَمُ الْخَلْقُ، حَتَّى تَرْفَعَ الْفَرَسُ حَافِرَهَا عَنْ وَلَدِهَا خَشْيَةَ أَنْ تُصِيبَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Al-Hakam ibn Nafi informed us; Shuayb informed us, from al-Zuhri, who said: Said ibn al-Musayyab informed us that Abu Hurairah said: I heard the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, say: “Allah made mercy one hundred parts. He kept ninety-nine parts with Himself and sent down one part to earth. By that one part, creation shows mercy to one another, so much so that a mare lifts her hoof from her foal for fear of hurting it.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 6005, book 78, باب فَضْلِ مَنْ يَعُولُ يَتِيمًا
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْوَهَّابِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي قَالَ، سَمِعْتُ سَهْلَ بْنَ سَعْدٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ أَنَا وَكَافِلُ الْيَتِيمِ، فِي الْجَنَّةِ هَكَذَا ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ بِإِصْبَعَيْهِ السَّبَّابَةِ وَالْوُسْطَى‏.‏
en_text: Abdullah ibn Abd al-Wahhab narrated to us, saying: Abd al-Aziz ibn Abi Hazim narrated to me, saying: My father narrated to me: I heard Sahl ibn Sad, from the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, who said: “I and the caretaker of an orphan will be in Paradise like this.” He held up his index and middle fingers.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 6007, book 78, باب السَّاعِي عَلَى الْمِسْكِينِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ ثَوْرِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الْغَيْثِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ السَّاعِي عَلَى الأَرْمَلَةِ وَالْمِسْكِينِ كَالْمُجَاهِدِ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ـ وَأَحْسِبُهُ قَالَ، يَشُكُّ الْقَعْنَبِيُّ ـ كَالْقَائِمِ لاَ يَفْتُرُ، وَكَالصَّائِمِ لاَ يُفْطِرُ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Abdullah ibn Maslamah narrated to us; Malik narrated to us, from Thawr ibn Zayd, from Abu al-Ghayth, from Abu Hurairah, may Allah be pleased with him, who said: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said: “The one who strives to support a widow and a poor person is like a fighter in the way of Allah”—and I think he said, al-Qanabi was uncertain—“like one who stands in prayer without tiring and one who fasts without breaking his fast.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 6011, book 78, باب رَحْمَةِ النَّاسِ وَالْبَهَائِمِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّاءُ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ النُّعْمَانَ بْنَ بَشِيرٍ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ تَرَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ فِي تَرَاحُمِهِمْ وَتَوَادِّهِمْ وَتَعَاطُفِهِمْ كَمَثَلِ الْجَسَدِ إِذَا اشْتَكَى عُضْوًا تَدَاعَى لَهُ سَائِرُ جَسَدِهِ بِالسَّهَرِ وَالْحُمَّى ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Abu Nuaim narrated to us; Zakariyya narrated to us, from Amir, who said: I heard him say: I heard al-Numan ibn Bashir say: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said: “You see the believers in their mutual mercy, love, and compassion as one body: when one part suffers, the rest of the body responds with sleeplessness and fever.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 6012, book 78, باب رَحْمَةِ النَّاسِ وَالْبَهَائِمِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ مَا مِنْ مُسْلِمٍ غَرَسَ غَرْسًا فَأَكَلَ مِنْهُ إِنْسَانٌ أَوْ دَابَّةٌ إِلاَّ كَانَ لَهُ صَدَقَةً ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Abu al-Walid narrated to us; Abu Awanah narrated to us, from Qatadah, from Anas ibn Malik, from the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, who said: “Whenever a Muslim plants a plant and a person or an animal eats from it, it is charity for him.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 6013, book 78, باب رَحْمَةِ النَّاسِ وَالْبَهَائِمِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ حَفْصٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي زَيْدُ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جَرِيرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ لاَ يَرْحَمُ لاَ يُرْحَمُ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Umar ibn Hafs narrated to us; my father narrated to us; al-Amash narrated to us, saying: Zayd ibn Wahb narrated to me: I heard Jarir ibn Abdullah report from the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, who said: “Whoever does not show mercy will not be shown mercy.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 6014, book 78, باب الْوَصَاةِ بِالْجَارِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أَبِي أُوَيْسٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ عَمْرَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ مَا زَالَ يُوصِينِي جِبْرِيلُ بِالْجَارِ حَتَّى ظَنَنْتُ أَنَّهُ سَيُوَرِّثُهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
